newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds TSB raises 250 mln stg via two bond issues. [CORRECTED 09:05 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Lloyds TSB raises 250 mln stg via two bond issues. [CORRECTED 09:05 GMT]

text.p: Lloyds TSB Group Plc has launched two bonds worth a total 250 million stg, lead manager SBC Warburg said.
(Corrects amount in headline and first paragraph from 300 million to 250 million).
There is a 15-year fixed-rate bond which will be priced later at a 150 basis points yield spread over gilts and a 150 million stg structured FRN.
